judul: Eggplant Detection and Counting Across the Entire Greenhouse Using Deep Learning and Motion Parallax
sumber: 10th IEEE International Smart Cities Conference Smart Cities Revolution for Mankind Isc2 2024 Proceedings
abstrak: To address labor shortages and population growth, the importance of maximizing productivity through precision agriculture is increasing. As part of precision agriculture, counting the number of fruits on crops is conducted to monitor growth conditions and predict yields. Manual counting is inaccurate and costly, so methods using object detection technologies to count fruits have been proposed. However, existing methods count all visible fruits in the frame, leading to duplicate counts and inaccuracies in measuring the total number of fruits throughout the greenhouse. In this paper, we propose a method for accurately counting the number of eggplants in an agricultural greenhouse by using an object detection model and an object tracking model. Our method utilizes the principle of motion parallax to prevent double counting and ensure accurate counts of each ridge. This approach leads to a more precise estimate of the total number of fruits in the greenhouse. The proposed method was evaluated using object tracking metrics and a comparison with the actual fruit count, and the results showed superior performance compared to existing methods. This demonstrates that our approach is more suitable for estimating the total number of fruits throughout the entire greenhouse.
